narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: tax is computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

The bug was in `orderTotal` at [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Tax was computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, so any case with both a discount and a tax was wrong.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Next: nothing.
